knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=The input DGE analytical object or data frame (from Cuffdiff, DESeq2, or edgeR) ;; type=Tells the function how to process the data for each analytical type (must be 'cuffdiff', 'deseq', or 'edger') ;; d.factor=Used specifically for DESeq2 objects to specify the experimental design factor (e.g., 'condition'); must be NULL for Cuffdiff and edgeR ;; aes=Aesthetic variant for box plots (options: "box", "violin", "boxdot", "viodot", "viosumm", "notch") ;; fill.color=Color palette for box plots, based on RColorBrewer palettes (e.g., "RdGy", "Paired", "Greys") ;; padj=Adjusted p-value threshold for significance (e.g., 0.05) ;; lfc=Log fold change threshold for highlighting or filtering ;; highlight=A vector of specific gene/transcript IDs to highlight in point-based plots ;; data.return=Logical; if TRUE, returns a list containing both the processed data frame ($data or [[1]]) and the ggplot object ($plot or [[2]])
- alternatives: The documentation does not mention alternative packages for visualization, but notes that the developmental version of vidger can be installed via GitHub using devtools::install_github("btmonier/vidger", ref = "devel") as an alternative to the stable Bioconductor release.
- when_to_use: Use vidger when you have completed a differential gene expression (DGE) analysis using Cuffdiff, DESeq2, or edgeR and want to rapidly generate information-rich, publication-ready visualizations (such as box plots, scatter plots, MA plots, volcano plots, and four-way plots) to interpret and explore your results.
- pitfalls: d.factor must be specified when using DESeq2 objects (type = 'deseq'), but should be set to NULL for Cuffdiff and edgeR ;; Highlighting is only supported in point-based plots (vsScatterPlot(), vsMAPlot(), vsVolcano(), vsFourWay()) ;; When data.return = TRUE, the function returns a list instead of directly rendering the plot, so you must subset it ([[1]] or $data for data, [[2]] or $plot for the plot) to access the components.

workflows.name: cuffdiff_dge_visualization
workflows.intent: Visualize and interpret differential gene expression results generated by Cuffdiff.
input: df.cuff (Cuffdiff output object/data frame containing FPKM and DGE statistics)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate box plots to check FPKM distribution across treatments using vsBoxPlot() ;; 2. Create scatter plots and scatter matrices to compare FPKM values between treatments using vsScatterPlot() and vsScatterMatrix() ;; 3. Visualize the number of DEGs at a given adjusted p-value using vsDEGMatrix() ;; 4. Generate MA plots and MA matrices to visualize variance and log fold changes using vsMAPlot() and vsMAMatrix() ;; 5. Create volcano plots and volcano matrices to compare significance against log fold changes using vsVolcano() and vsVolcanoMatrix() ;; 6. Compare two treatments against a control using vsFourWay()
workflows.code:
vsBoxPlot(
    data = df.cuff, d.factor = NULL, type = 'cuffdiff', title = TRUE, 
    legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsScatterPlot(
    x = 'hESC', y = 'iPS', data = df.cuff, type = 'cuffdiff',
    d.factor = NULL, title = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsScatterMatrix(
    data = df.cuff, d.factor = NULL, type = 'cuffdiff', 
    comp = NULL, title = TRUE, grid = TRUE, man.title = NULL
)
vsDEGMatrix(
    data = df.cuff, padj = 0.05, d.factor = NULL, type = 'cuffdiff', 
    title = TRUE, legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsMAPlot(
    x = 'iPS', y = 'hESC', data = df.cuff, d.factor = NULL, 
    type = 'cuffdiff', padj = 0.05, y.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, 
    title = TRUE, legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsMAMatrix(
    data = df.cuff, d.factor = NULL, type = 'cuffdiff', 
    padj = 0.05, y.lim = NULL, lfc = 1, title = TRUE, 
    grid = TRUE, counts = TRUE, data.return = FALSE
)
vsVolcano(
    x = 'iPS', y = 'hESC', data = df.cuff, d.factor = NULL, 
    type = 'cuffdiff', padj = 0.05, x.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, 
    title = TRUE, legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE, data.return = FALSE
)
vsVolcanoMatrix(
    data = df.cuff, d.factor = NULL, type = 'cuffdiff', 
    padj = 0.05, x.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, title = TRUE, 
    legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE, counts = TRUE
)
vsFourWay(
    x = 'iPS', y = 'hESC', control = 'Fibroblasts', data = df.cuff,
    d.factor = NULL, type = 'cuffdiff', padj = 0.05, x.lim = NULL,
    y.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, legend = TRUE, title = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)

workflows.name: deseq2_dge_visualization
workflows.intent: Visualize and interpret differential gene expression results generated by DESeq2.
input: df.deseq (DESeq2 results object/data frame containing normalized counts and DGE statistics)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate box plots to check FPKM/normalized count distribution across treatments using vsBoxPlot() with d.factor specified ;; 2. Create scatter plots and scatter matrices to compare expression values between treatments using vsScatterPlot() and vsScatterMatrix() ;; 3. Visualize the number of DEGs at a given adjusted p-value using vsDEGMatrix() ;; 4. Generate MA plots and MA matrices to visualize variance and log fold changes using vsMAPlot() and vsMAMatrix() ;; 5. Create volcano plots and volcano matrices to compare significance against log fold changes using vsVolcano() and vsVolcanoMatrix() ;; 6. Compare two treatments against a control using vsFourWay()
workflows.code:
vsBoxPlot(
    data = df.deseq, d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq', 
    title = TRUE, legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsScatterPlot(
    x = 'treated_paired.end', y = 'untreated_paired.end', 
    data = df.deseq, type = 'deseq', d.factor = 'condition', 
    title = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsScatterMatrix(
    data = df.deseq, d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq',
    comp = NULL, title = TRUE, grid = TRUE, man.title = NULL
)
vsDEGMatrix(
    data = df.deseq, padj = 0.05, d.factor = 'condition', 
    type = 'deseq', title = TRUE, legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsMAPlot(
    x = 'treated_paired.end', y = 'untreated_paired.end', 
    data = df.deseq, d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq', 
    padj = 0.05, y.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, title = TRUE, 
    legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
vsMAMatrix(
    data = df.deseq, d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq', 
    padj = 0.05, y.lim = NULL, lfc = 1, title = TRUE, 
    grid = TRUE, counts = TRUE, data.return = FALSE
)
vsVolcano(
    x = 'treated_paired.end', y = 'untreated_paired.end', 
    data = df.deseq, d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq', 
    padj = 0.05, x.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, title = TRUE, 
    legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE, data.return = FALSE
)
vsVolcanoMatrix(
    data = df.deseq, d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq', 
    padj = 0.05, x.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, title = TRUE, 
    legend = TRUE, grid = TRUE, counts = TRUE
)
vsFourWay(
    x = 'treated_paired.end', y = 'untreated_single.read', 
    control = 'untreated_paired.end', data = df.deseq, 
    d.factor = 'condition', type = 'deseq', padj = 0.05, x.lim = NULL, 
    y.lim = NULL, lfc = NULL, legend = TRUE, title = TRUE, grid = TRUE
)
